exposure: Intrapartum transperineal ultrasonographic (ITU) parameters (angle of progression (AoP), head-perineum distance (HPD), midline angle (MLA))
outcome: Delivery mode (spontaneous vaginal delivery, operative vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 104 pregnant women in active labor with ruptured membranes at Duzce University Health Application and Research Center.
finding: Intrapartum transperineal ultrasonography (ITU) parameters, specifically AoP, HPD, and MLA, provide objective and reliable data valuable for predicting delivery mode during active labor.
mod_finding: AoP and MLA measurements were significantly associated with spontaneous vaginal delivery, while HPD was higher in the cesarean section group and DAoP was lower in the operative vaginal delivery group.
